licence.scope: Step 2 (owner's data terms): NASA Science Data Portal licence statement for data from NASA-led missions, applied to the Mars 2020 Mastcam-Z (NASA/JPL mission; ASU-led instrument team). The ASU team page for its mosaics (https://mastcamz.asu.edu/mastcam-zs-landscape-mosaic-collection/) says they are free to use without explicit permission and asks for the credit below; it covers mosaics, not filter curves. ; it does not cover third-party material marked with a restrictive notice. Same statement and class as Cassini__ISS_NAC, Dawn__FC, Galileo__SSI. Source page SVO cites: https://mars.nasa.gov/mars2020/spacecraft/instruments/mastcam-z/ (now https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/science-instruments/). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
